test_accelerator_prepare_components: test that Accelerator.prepare correctly wraps model, optimizer, scheduler, and dataloaders for distributed training
test_accelerator_save_load_state: test saving and loading full training state including model weights, optimizer, and scheduler with safetensors
test_accelerator_save_model_sharded: test saving a model as sharded checkpoint files with a configurable max shard size limit
test_accelerator_unwrap_model: test unwrapping a prepared model to retrieve the original module after mixed precision or distributed wrapping
test_accelerator_free_memory: test freeing memory by dereferencing all prepared components and clearing internal accelerator references
